title: Good: sign.rs random_boundary retry loop has correct probability analysis
description: smime-tree/src/sign.rs: random_boundary() generates a 16-byte random boundary (128 bits of entropy) and retries up to 8 times if the boundary happens to appear in the content. The probability of any one boundary colliding with the content is at most 2^-128 per occurrence, making 8 retries overkill but not wrong. More importantly, the retry loop means boundary collision cannot cause a panic or a corrupted output — it always either finds a safe boundary or returns an error. This is the correct pattern: never panic on PRNG output, always have a bounded retry count, and return Err on exhaustion rather than producing a bad result.
close_reason: Positive review finding — design decision worth defending. No change needed.
